English key: LB / RB as your own buttons, camera zoom, and where they sit.
zhCN text: 将 L1/R1 设为独立按键，调整镜头缩放及按钮位置。

English key: L3 / R3 as your own buttons, and where they sit.
zhCN text: 将 L3/R3 设置成独立按键并调整按钮位置。

English key: L4 / R4 / L5 / R5 paddles and the E1 - E4 extra buttons: on / off, setup, and where they sit.
zhCN text: 启用或关闭 L4/R4/L5/R5 背键和 E1–E4 扩展键，并设置它们的功能与显示位置。

English key: The window wheel, the consumables wheel and the quest item button.
zhCN text: 窗口轮盘、消耗品轮盘及任务物品按钮。

English key: Per-class extras, like warrior stance sets.
zhCN text: 各职业专属设置，例如战士姿态按键方案。

English key: Scale, move, spread and fade the whole layout, and how out of range looks.
zhCN text: 调整整体布局的缩放、移动、间距和淡出，以及超出距离时的显示方式。

English key: Button symbols, the Start menu, the crosshair and the mouse.
zhCN text: 调整按钮图标、Start 菜单、准星与鼠标显示。

English key: Reset Buttons Moved One by One
zhCN text: 重置单独移动过的按钮

English key: Buttons you moved one by one go back on their group. Groups stay put.
zhCN text: 将单独移动的按钮恢复到所属按键组，按键组整体位置不变。

English key: Glass-like buttons: the picture, its backing and the ring let the world show through. Symbols, numbers and glows stay solid.
zhCN text: 玻璃质感按键：图标、背景和边框均带透明效果，可以看到背后的游戏画面。按键符号、数字和高亮效果仍保持清晰。

English key: On: seconds left in big numbers on a button on cooldown.
zhCN text: 技能冷却时在按钮上用大号数字显示剩余秒数。

English key: On: your interrupt flashes red while the target casts. Experimental.
zhCN text: 目标正在读条时，打断技能按钮闪红提示（实验性）。
超出施法距离提示颜色

English key: Abilities cooling down on the modifiers you aren't holding: Off, a Row of icons side by side, or a List (one per line, soonest first).
zhCN text: 显示当前没有按住的其他组合键层的技能冷却。可关闭，或显示为横向图标行，或按剩余冷却时间从短到长排列的竖向列表。
距离下次自动攻击的剩余时间

English key: On: Controller Forever's crosshair, in the style below. Off: the game's own (Crosshair Opacity still works on it).
zhCN text: 开启后使用下方设置的 Controller Forever 准星；关闭后使用游戏原生准星（准星不透明度设置仍然有效）。

English key: Brackets round your target: red enemy, green friend, yellow neutral. Needs nameplates on.
zhCN text: 目标周围显示边框：敌对为红色、友方为绿色、中立为黄色。需启用姓名板。

English key: Your target's edge: green low threat, yellow close to pulling, red you have aggro (Threat Color). Or your Class Color, Gold, or Off.
zhCN text: 当前目标的边框颜色可以反映仇恨：绿色代表仇恨较低，黄色代表即将获得仇恨，红色代表你已成为攻击目标。也可选择职业颜色、金色或关闭。

English key: On: an arrow past the frame in the colour of the party member it's hitting (none when it's you: the red square says so).
zhCN text: 开启后，在敌人框体旁显示箭头，箭头采用被攻击队友的职业颜色。如果敌人攻击的是你，则不显示箭头，改由红色方框提示。

English key: A: type a new name for this Custom Wheel.
zhCN text: 按 A 为这个自定义轮盘输入新名称。

English key: Round, Square, Hexagon, Octagon, Flower or Gear.
zhCN text: 圆形、方形、六角形、八角形、花朵或齿轮。
显示 A / B 提示

English key: On: while a wheel is open, the camera holds still for mouse, trackpad and gyro. Holding a mouse button still turns it.
zhCN text: 开启后，在快捷轮盘打开期间，鼠标、触控板和陀螺仪不会转动镜头；按住鼠标按键仍然可以转动镜头。

English key: Your buffs that aren't on you
zhCN text: 你身上没有的增益效果

English key: Your swing timer is hidden in the game's Edit Mode. To see it in play: Edit Mode > Swing Timer > Visibility: Always or In Combat.
zhCN text: 游戏的编辑模式中已隐藏自动攻击计时条。如需显示，请进入“编辑模式 → 自动攻击计时条 → 可见性”，选择“始终”或“战斗中”。

English key: The mark in the middle of the screen.
Enemies your group is fighting. Needs enemy name plates.
zhCN text: 显示你的小队正在交战的敌人，需要启用敌方姓名板。

English key: On: the controller vibrates for the things below that are on.
zhCN text: 开启手柄震动后，可由下方各项指定触发场景。

English key: A light tap when you use an ability. A turns it on or off; D-pad left / right: how strong.
zhCN text: 使用技能时短震动一次。按 A 启用／关闭；左右方向键调整强度。

English key: A pulse when a cast finishes. A turns it on or off; D-pad left / right: how strong.
zhCN text: 施法完成时震动一次。按 A 启用／关闭；左右方向键调整强度。

English key: A soft rumble while you cast. A turns it on or off; D-pad left / right: how strong.
zhCN text: 引导或读条施法期间轻微震动。按 A 启用／关闭；左右方向键调整强度。

English key: A sharp jolt when a cast is interrupted. A turns it on or off; D-pad left / right: how strong.
zhCN text: 施法被打断时明显震动一次。按 A 启用／关闭；左右方向键调整强度。

English key: A tap each time you are hit. A turns it on or off; D-pad left / right: how strong.
zhCN text: 受到攻击时轻微震动。按 A 启用／关闭；左右方向键调整强度。

English key: A jolt on a critical hit. A turns it on or off; D-pad left / right: how strong.
zhCN text: 受到暴击时明显震动。按 A 启用／关闭；左右方向键调整强度。

English key: A pulse when a fight starts. A turns it on or off; D-pad left / right: how strong.
zhCN text: 进入战斗时震动一次。按 A 启用／关闭；左右方向键调整强度。

English key: A tap when a fight ends. A turns it on or off; D-pad left / right: how strong.
zhCN text: 脱离战斗时轻微震动。按 A 启用／关闭；左右方向键调整强度。

English key: A tap when you jump. A turns it on or off; D-pad left / right: how strong.
zhCN text: 跳跃时短震动一次。按 A 启用／关闭；左右方向键调整强度。

English key: A pulse when someone whispers you. A turns it on or off; D-pad left / right: how strong.
zhCN text: 收到密语时震动提醒。按 A 启用／关闭；左右方向键调整强度。

English key: A jolt when you hook a fish. A turns it on or off; D-pad left / right: how strong.
zhCN text: 钓鱼上钩时震动提醒。按 A 启用／关闭；左右方向键调整强度。

English key: The camera comes in close while you talk to anyone.
zhCN text: 与 NPC 交谈时镜头会自动拉近。
物品选择器（附魔、毒药、石头）

English key: On: in the Mini Bag one A disenchants the lit item at once. A disenchanted item can't be got back. Off: A asks first, A again disenchants.
zhCN text: 开启后，在迷你背包里对选中的装备按一次 A 即可立即分解。分解后无法找回；关闭后第一次按 A 显示确认，再按一次才执行分解。

English key: On: a small button on the minimap opens the list.
zhCN text: 开启：小地图上的小按钮可打开列表。
在小地图标记当前选项

English key: The bar at the left edge.
zhCN text: 位于屏幕左侧的额外动作条。

English key: The bar at the right edge.
zhCN text: 位于屏幕右侧的额外动作条。
编辑布局：整个十字方向键

English key: Edit Layout: All A B X Y
zhCN text: 编辑布局：全部 A B X Y

English key: Size of the icons on A / B / X / Y and the D-pad.
zhCN text: 调整 A／B／X／Y 及十字方向键图标的大小。

English key: A second D-pad set for a fight or a hostile target. Bind it: All Keybinds, L3.
zhCN text: 进入战斗或选中敌对目标时，为十字方向键启用另一套按键绑定。可在“全部按键绑定 → L3”中设置。

English key: A second LB / RB set for a fight or a hostile target. Bind it: All Keybinds, L3.
zhCN text: 进入战斗或选中敌对目标时，为 LB／RB 启用另一套按键绑定。可在“全部按键绑定 → L3”中设置。

English key: A second L3 / R3 set for a fight or a hostile target. Bind it: All Keybinds, L3.
zhCN text: 进入战斗或选中敌对目标时，为 L3／R3 启用另一套按键绑定。可在“全部按键绑定 → L3”中设置。

English key: A second Start set for a fight or a hostile target. Bind it: All Keybinds, L3.
zhCN text: 进入战斗或选中敌对目标时，为 Start 启用另一套按键绑定。可在“全部按键绑定 → L3”中设置。

English key: A second Select set for a fight or a hostile target. Bind it: All Keybinds, L3.
zhCN text: 进入战斗或选中敌对目标时，为 Select 启用另一套按键绑定。可在“全部按键绑定 → L3”中设置。

English key: A second L4 / R4 set for a fight or a hostile target. Bind it: All Keybinds, L3.
zhCN text: 进入战斗或选中敌对目标时，为 L4／R4 启用另一套按键绑定。可在“全部按键绑定 → L3”中设置。

English key: A second L5 / R5 set for a fight or a hostile target. Bind it: All Keybinds, L3.
zhCN text: 进入战斗或选中敌对目标时，为 L5／R5 启用另一套按键绑定。可在“全部按键绑定 → L3”中设置。

English key: A second Xbox button set for a fight or a hostile target. Bind it: All Keybinds, L3.
zhCN text: 进入战斗或选中敌对目标时，为 Xbox／Home 键启用另一套按键绑定。可在“全部按键绑定 → L3”中设置。

English key: A second E1 - E4 set for a fight or a hostile target. Bind it: All Keybinds, L3.
zhCN text: 进入战斗或选中敌对目标时，为 E1–E4 启用另一套按键绑定。可在“全部按键绑定 → L3”中设置。
在“全部按键绑定”中编辑配置方案 1
每套配置方案可保存不同装备。

English key: Its own binds; the one you start with.
zhCN text: 此方案独立的按键绑定，也是你最初使用的方案。
此方案独立的按键绑定。
在“全部按键绑定”中编辑

English key: Aura Priority checks your own effects on the picked member on every press: your own buffs, not cooldowns, health, range or cast success (a shield can still fail while Weakened Soul is on). Missing rule 1 always takes priority again. Configure out of combat.
zhCN text: 每次按键检查所选队友身上由你施加的效果。只检测你的增益／持续治疗效果，不检测技能冷却、血量、距离或施法成功。目标有「虚弱灵魂」时护盾仍可能施放失败。请脱战配置。

English key: Single Heal mode uses this spell. Aura Priority: apply this first if your effect is missing. Off disables Press Again.
zhCN text: 单一治疗模式使用此技能；效果优先模式下，目标缺少该效果时优先尝试施放。关闭会禁用再次按键治疗。

English key: Aura Priority: cast this only when your earlier effects are present and this effect is missing. Choose a heal with a lasting buff, such as Regrowth or Renew; Off skips this rule.
zhCN text: 效果优先模式下，前序效果已存在且目标缺少此持续治疗效果时才尝试施放；适合「恢复」等持续治疗技能。关闭可跳过该规则。

English key: Choose a single heal or an aura priority: first missing heal-over-time or shield, then a fallback.
zhCN text: 选择单一治疗技能，或优先补缺失的持续治疗／护盾效果，然后使用后备治疗。

English key: With Party D-pad or 5 Buttons on. On: your combat sets work out of a fight too. Off: only in a fight, the same as with Party mode off.
zhCN text: 启用队伍方向键或 5 键选人时，可设置战斗按键组是否在非战斗状态也生效。开启：脱战也生效；关闭：只有战斗中生效，与队伍模式关闭时相同。

English key: Which four buttons pick: the D-pad, or A / B / X / Y.
zhCN text: 选择用于选队友的四个按键：十字方向键，或 A／B／X／Y。

English key: The modifier the Party Pick buttons are on. Off that modifier the buttons do their own binds.
zhCN text: 设置队友选择键在哪个组合键层生效；离开该组合层后，按键恢复原有绑定。

English key: Put Party Wheel on a Button
zhCN text: 将队友轮盘绑定到按键

English key: Pressing this bind turns the Party Wheel on and off (in a fight: when the fight ends). Off: the wheel never opens, even on a spell.
zhCN text: 按此快捷键可以打开／关闭队友轮盘。战斗中切换可能需要等到脱战；关闭轮盘后，即使施放友方技能也不会自动打开。

English key: On: a heal, cleanse or blessing with no friendly target opens the wheel. Point a stick at someone and let go: it's cast on them.
zhCN text: 开启后，当治疗、驱散或祝福技能没有有效友方目标时会打开队友轮盘。摇杆指向队友并松开即可施放该技能。

English key: Opens All Keybinds on your Party Set: its binds take over while a friend is your target. A button with nothing in it keeps its normal bind.
zhCN text: 在“全部按键绑定”中打开队伍治疗按键方案。选中友方目标时，队伍方案的绑定会生效；此方案中未设置的按钮继续沿用正常绑定。

English key: How the one you picked is marked: Corners, Thick Ring, Glow, Crosshair or Cursor. With Cursor, its own rows show beside it.
zhCN text: 选择队友时的标记样式：角标、粗圆环、发光、准星或光标。使用“光标”时，还会显示专属设置项。

English key: Its colour. Your focus target is always purple.
zhCN text: 设置标记颜色，焦点目标始终显示紫色。

English key: The fill's colour: the highlight's, or Gold, White, Blue, Red or Purple.
zhCN text: 设置填充颜色：可跟随高亮色，或使用金、白、蓝、红、紫等颜色。

English key: On: each press of its bind buffs the next player near you who needs your buff. In a fight it goes down the list made when the fight began.
zhCN text: 每次按键都会尝试为附近下一名缺少指定增益的队友施放技能。战斗期间按进入战斗时确定的队友列表顺序处理。

English key: A small line beside your party frames: how many need your buff and who's next. It flashes when someone new needs it. Move it in Edit Layout.
zhCN text: 在队伍框体旁显示一行提示，说明还有多少人缺少该增益，以及下一位施法目标。新的需求出现时会闪烁。可在“编辑布局”中移动。

English key: On: the bar button with a Buff Radar bind glows while someone near you needs its buff.
zhCN text: 附近有队友缺少指定增益时，对应的增益监控快捷键会发光提示。

English key: Press the button you want Buff Radar on. It's also in All Keybinds, Game Actions.
zhCN text: 按下要绑定增益监控的手柄按键。也可以在“全部按键绑定 → 游戏操作”中设置。

English key: A small line of its own, under Buff Radar's: how many need its buff and who's next. Move it in Edit Layout.
zhCN text: 在增益监控下方显示独立的第二行，标明需要补增益的人数和下一位目标。可在“编辑布局”中移动。

English key: A small line under Buff Radar's: how many need a dispel and who's next, in the debuff's colour. Move it in Edit Layout.
zhCN text: 在增益监控下方显示需要驱散的人数及下一位目标，并以负面效果颜色标记。可在“编辑布局”中移动。

English key: On: that glow pulses (the game's own pulse). Off: as the game had it.
zhCN text: 开启后，队伍框体高亮使用游戏原生脉冲效果；关闭后保留原本显示方式。

English key: On: the button with your Dispel Radar bind glows while someone near you has something you can remove.
zhCN text: 附近有队友中了你能驱散的效果时，驱散监控绑定的按键会发光提示。

English key: Put Dispel Radar on a Button
zhCN text: 将驱散雷达放在按钮上

English key: Press the button you want Dispel Radar on. It's also in All Keybinds, Game Actions.
zhCN text: 按下要绑定驱散监控的按键，也可以从“全部按键绑定 → 游戏操作”设置。

English key: How the one you pick is marked
You and your party in a ring, with health bars.
zhCN text: 将你和全部小队成员以环形排列，并显示各自的生命条。

English key: How the one you picked is marked.
zhCN text: 如何标记当前选中的队友。

English key: One bind buffs the next player who needs it.
zhCN text: 用一个快捷键为下一位缺少增益的队友施法。

English key: A bind of its own for one more of your buffs.
zhCN text: 为另一项增益法术设置独立快捷键。

English key: One bind removes the next debuff you can; frames light up for it.
zhCN text: 按一次快捷键尝试驱散下一名符合条件的队友，相关队伍框体会高亮提示。

English key: Hold a button about half a second, then let go, for a second bind on it. A quick tap does the button's own bind as you let go.
zhCN text: 按住按键约半秒再松开以触发第二个绑定；快速短按则执行该键的原有动作，动作在松开时生效。

English key: A second set of binds for a fight or a hostile target.
zhCN text: 用于战斗或敌对目标的第二组绑定。
按 R3 进入，或使用这里的 < 与 > 切换配置方案。

English key: -  D-pad Up past the top button reaches Extra Buttons and combo options.
zhCN text: 将十字方向键向上推过顶端按钮，可进入扩展按键及组合设置。

English key: Edit Layout: Move All L4 / R4
zhCN text: 编辑布局：移动所有 L4 / R4

English key: Edit Layout: Move All L5 / R5
zhCN text: 编辑布局：移动所有 L5 / R5

English key: Four more buttons (Flydigi C, Z, LM, RM). Set each up below first.
zhCN text: 另有四个扩展键（飞智 C、Z、LM、RM），请先分别完成下方设置。

English key: Edit Layout: Move All E1 - E4
zhCN text: 编辑布局：移动所有 E1 - E4
编辑布局：所有 G1 - G5

English key: Four more buttons (Flydigi C, Z, LM, RM).
zhCN text: 四个额外按键（飞智 C、Z、LM、RM）。

English key: The SCUF Envision's G1 - G5 row.
zhCN text: SCUF Envision 手柄的 G1–G5 按键组。

English key: Older settings-only profile. Load it, then Upgrade Older Profile to enable automatic saving. A: load (reloads). X: rename. Y: delete.
zhCN text: 这是只保存设置的旧版配置文件。加载后，可通过“升级旧配置文件”将其转换为新格式并启用自动保存。A：加载并重载界面；X：重命名；Y：删除。

English key: Turn an older settings-only profile into one that saves itself, from your look, layout and settings now.
zhCN text: 将仅含设置的旧版配置文件升级为新的可保存格式，并使用你当前的外观、布局和设置。

English key: Put back the look, layout and settings you had before the last profile load. Binds aren't touched. Reloads.
zhCN text: 恢复上次加载配置文件前的外观、布局及设置，按键绑定不会改变。需要重新加载界面。

English key: Puts your Default Settings on this character now. Binds stay. Reloads; Undo Reset Settings puts yours back.
zhCN text: 将保存的默认设置应用到当前角色，保留按键绑定并重新加载界面。可通过“撤销重置设置”恢复。

English key: This character's binds only. A: load (reloads; not while Lock My Binds is on). X: rename. Y: delete.
zhCN text: 仅显示当前角色保存的按键绑定。按 A 加载（需要重新加载界面，锁定按键时不可用）；X 重命名；Y 删除。

English key: Puts your Default Keybinds on this loadout now. Your class abilities stay where it has nothing. Undo Keybind Load puts yours back.
zhCN text: 将默认按键方案应用到当前配置方案。未被覆盖的职业技能保持原位；可使用“撤销按键方案加载”恢复。

English key: Discover setups shared by group members and request them without targeting anyone. Experimental.
zhCN text: 发现其他小队成员共享的配置方案，可以在不选中目标的情况下请求获取（实验性）。

English key: Every setting back to Controller Forever's own settings. Binds stay. Reloads. Undo below.
zhCN text: 将全部设置恢复为 Controller Forever 默认值，但保留按键绑定。界面会重新加载，可使用下方撤销功能恢复。

English key: Settings saved only for new characters.
zhCN text: 仅供新角色使用的已保存设置。

English key: Set up and lock your binds, save this character's binds only (My Keybinds), or save the binds new characters start with.
zhCN text: 设置及锁定快捷键，可仅保存当前角色的按键方案，或保存新角色使用的默认按键方案。

English key: Your setup as a code for a friend (export), or load one (import).
zhCN text: 将当前配置导出为代码供其他玩家使用，或导入他人分享的配置代码。

English key: Binds or settings back to the start, and their undos.
zhCN text: 恢复初始按键绑定或设置，并提供撤销选项。

English key: How big the Trigger Bar is, on top of your whole layout's size.
zhCN text: 在整体布局缩放设置基础上，单独调整扳机动作条的大小。

English key: The Trigger Bar back where it starts, at its starting size, Dim Others too.
zhCN text: 将扳机动作条恢复默认位置、大小及其他动作条淡化设置。

English key: Bind Select On (to start): Select alone is the game's Select, LT + Select this menu. Off: Select opens this menu.
zhCN text: 启用 Select 自定义绑定：单按 Select 使用游戏原本功能，LT＋Select 打开本菜单。关闭：单按 Select 直接打开本菜单。

English key: This menu bigger or smaller (60% - 150%). It never gets bigger than your screen.
zhCN text: 将此菜单缩放至 60%–150%，但不会超过屏幕范围。
使游戏原生 Start 菜单居中显示。

English key: On: every button gets a ring in your form or stance colour.
zhCN text: 在各动作按钮周围显示当前形态或姿态的代表色圆环。
交互键可停止自动攻击

English key: With Auto Loot on: the loot window doesn't pop up while it empties. If something is left (full bags, an item that asks first) it shows.
zhCN text: 启用自动拾取后，物品自动进入背包时不弹出拾取窗口。如果背包已满或某件物品需要确认，仍会显示窗口。

English key: On Screen: who and what, a moment. Reply Box: the reply keyboard opens (out of a fight). Bind: Reply to Whisper.
zhCN text: 屏幕提示：短暂显示发信人和密语内容。回复框：脱战时打开手柄回复键盘。还可单独绑定“回复密语”快捷键。

English key: Where the voice chat app's lines go (/cfchat). Back to Auto at every login. Bind: Voice Chat Channel toggles it in game.
zhCN text: 设置语音聊天应用的消息发送到哪个频道（/cfchat）；每次登录恢复为自动模式。也可以通过“语音聊天频道”快捷键在游戏中切换。

English key: On: after a reload, one line in chat says when Controller Forever recorded problems, and where the file to send is.
zhCN text: 开启后，重新加载界面时，如果 Controller Forever 曾记录错误，会在聊天框显示记录时间与可提交的日志文件位置。

English key: Takes quests for you. Not with the game's controller UI on: there your A takes them.
zhCN text: 自动接受任务。若游戏原生手柄界面已开启，则由 A 键操作任务接取，本功能不接管。

English key: With the controller UI: the first page is turned for you, the reward is your A (closing it from an addon breaks LT / RT).
zhCN text: 使用手柄界面时自动推进任务对话的第一页，但任务奖励仍需你按 A 选择；由其他插件强行关闭任务对话可能打断 LT／RT 操作。

English key: What touching the mouse or trackpad does while on the controller.
zhCN text: 使用手柄时，触摸鼠标或触控板应触发的行为。

English key: On: a click or tap frees the pointer until you touch the controller.
zhCN text: 开启后，点击鼠标或轻触触控板将暂时释放鼠标指针，直到再次使用手柄。

English key: Steam Deck: the trackpad pointer picks in wheels.
zhCN text: Steam Deck：使用触控板指针选择轮盘菜单项。

English key: How fast the right stick moves the Mouse Pointer bind.
zhCN text: 右摇杆控制“鼠标指针”快捷键时的移动速度。

English key: How the menu and the game's messages act.
zhCN text: 菜单与游戏消息的显示和操作方式。

English key: Whispers and the voice chat app's lines.
zhCN text: 密语与语音聊天工具的消息。
与任务 NPC 的对话设置。

English key: The trackpad, the mouse and the stick pointer.
zhCN text: 触控板、鼠标及摇杆控制的指针。

English key: Edit Layout: Both LB and RB
Holding LB / RB: Hold Binds Only
zhCN text: 长按 LB／RB：只执行长按绑定

English key: On (to start): only a quick tap does LB's / RB's own bind. Held (in a fight too), only your hold binds work.
zhCN text: 开启后，快速短按 LB／RB 执行该键原有动作；长按时（包括战斗中）只触发设定的长按绑定。

English key: LB / RB as your own buttons. Hold both and push the right stick to zoom.
zhCN text: 将 LB／RB 设为独立按钮。同时按住两键并推动右摇杆可以缩放镜头。

English key: LB / RB holds (on while LB / RB are modifiers): bind them in All Keybinds.
zhCN text: 当 LB／RB 作为组合键时，可在“全部按键绑定”中设置其长按操作。

English key: Off: that button is a plain button, its hold binds wait.
zhCN text: 关闭后，该键按普通按钮处理，长按绑定不会触发。

English key: Make It My Own: every skin on, every line yours to change. Left / right: the next look.
zhCN text: 使用自定义外观：允许修改所有皮肤与各项细节。左右方向键切换其他预设。

English key: One colour for the borders and frame art of every skin.
zhCN text: 使用一种强调色统一控制各皮肤的边框和装饰框体。

English key: The border round the minimap, chat and meter.
zhCN text: 小地图、聊天窗与伤害统计面板的边框。

English key: Dark: solid black behind the chat and meter.
zhCN text: 深色：聊天及伤害统计面板采用纯黑背景。

English key: The bars of the meter and your frames.
zhCN text: 伤害统计与单位框体中生命／资源条的纹理。

English key: Dark: the game's tooltips in a flat dark panel with a thin edge.
zhCN text: 深色：游戏的工具提示位于带有细边的平坦深色面板中。

English key: A dark edge round the text.
zhCN text: 为文字加上深色轮廓，使其更容易辨认。

English key: Every bit of game text in this font. Experimental. Your Own Font: as CF Look > Font says.
zhCN text: 将此字体应用到游戏所有文字（实验性）。若使用自定义字体，请按“CF 外观 → 字体”的说明放置文件。

English key: Every bit of game text smaller or bigger. Experimental.
zhCN text: 统一放大或缩小游戏中的文字（实验性）。
CF 窗口：使用文字显示金币

English key: Prices as 3g 30s 40c instead of coin pictures, in Controller Forever's own windows.
zhCN text: 在 CF 自定义窗口中，以 3g 30s 40c 这样的文本显示价格，而不是金币、银币、铜币图标。
CF 窗口：同时显示游戏原生提示框

English key: The game's own item tooltip beside Controller Forever's windows too (it covers part of the screen).
zhCN text: 在 CF 自定义窗口旁同时显示游戏原生物品提示框；可能遮挡部分界面。

English key: How big Controller Forever's own windows are, 80 to 110 %.
zhCN text: 调整 CF 自定义窗口大小，范围 80%–110%。

English key: Move Your Frame in Edit Layout
zhCN text: 在编辑布局中移动玩家框体

English key: Mirror Target Frame With Your Frame
zhCN text: 使目标框体与玩家框体镜像排列

English key: On: your target's frame sits opposite yours, the same height, as in a mirror. Move yours and it follows.
zhCN text: 开启后，当前目标框体与玩家框体左右对称、高度一致；移动玩家框体时目标框体会跟随。

English key: Move the Target Frame in Edit Layout
zhCN text: 在编辑布局中移动目标框体

English key: Classic: the old silver border on vendor, mail, quest and other small windows. Reloads.
zhCN text: 经典：为商人、邮箱、任务等小窗口使用旧版银色边框。修改后需要重新加载界面。
要替换外观的单位框体

English key: The art round the portrait and bars, an elite's gold dragon and the level's circle too.
zhCN text: 头像和生命／资源条周围的装饰，包括精英怪的金龙标记及等级圆环。

English key: A face, a class icon, or no portrait.
zhCN text: 选择显示角色头像、职业图标，或不显示头像。
调整单位框体的透明度。
设置战斗状态下同样的透明度。

English key: Class / Reaction colours, or Green to Red by health.
zhCN text: 使用职业／敌友关系颜色，或根据血量从绿色渐变到红色。

English key: The health bar changes colour under this much health.
zhCN text: 生命值低于指定阈值时改变生命条颜色。
选择低生命值提示颜色。

English key: The mana / rage / energy bar's fill.
zhCN text: 调整法力、怒气及能量条的填充效果。

English key: Pixels between your frame's health and power bars, so their numbers read apart. Left / right.
zhCN text: 调整单位框体内生命条和资源条之间的像素间距，便于区分数值。左右方向键调整。
生命值与资源数值的显示。

English key: A spark on your mana bar for the 5 seconds after a spell. Experimental.
zhCN text: 在施法后的五秒回蓝限制期间，于法力条显示计时光效（实验性）。
德鲁伊变形时显示法力

English key: Druids: a thin mana bar in Bear and Cat Form. Experimental.
zhCN text: 德鲁伊使用熊形态或猎豹形态时显示细法力条（实验性）。

English key: Your threat on the target, as a % over its frame. Experimental.
zhCN text: 在目标框体上显示你对该目标的仇恨百分比（实验性）。

English key: The name, level and numbers' font. Your Own Font: as CF Look > Font says.
zhCN text: 姓名、等级及数值的字体。自定义字体方法见“CF 外观 → 字体”。

English key: The name, level and numbers' size.
zhCN text: 姓名、等级与数值文字的大小。

English key: A dark edge round the letters.
The level number and its circle.
zhCN text: 显示等级数字及其圆环。

English key: The coloured strip behind the target's name.
zhCN text: 目标名称后面的彩色背景条。

English key: The red fight glow and the yellow rest glow.
zhCN text: 战斗时的红色高亮，以及休息时的黄色高亮。

English key: Damage and healing numbers over your portrait.
zhCN text: 显示在角色头像上的伤害及治疗数字。
休息状态 Zzz 标记

English key: The Zzz by your portrait when resting.
zhCN text: 休息时在头像旁显示 Zzz 标记。

English key: The PvP badge by the portrait.
zhCN text: 显示在头像旁的 PvP 标记。

English key: The leader crown, guide and role icons.
zhCN text: 队长皇冠、团队向导及职责标记。

English key: The Group tag over your frame in a raid.
zhCN text: 团队中显示角色所处小队的编号。

English key: The rare star, boss skull and quest badges.
zhCN text: 稀有怪星形、首领骷髅及任务标记。

English key: The gold piece on the player portrait's corner.
zhCN text: 玩家头像角落的金色装饰。

English key: The art round each portrait and bars.
zhCN text: 头像及生命／资源条周围的装饰。

English key: The thin lines round each raid-style frame. Crisp Line: ours, a sharp edge with a soft shadow.
zhCN text: 团队风格框体周围的细边线。“锐利描边”使用带柔和阴影的清晰线条。

English key: How see-through the party frames are (the raid frames too, in a raid).
zhCN text: 调整小队框体的透明度；团队中也会应用于团队框体。

English key: Class colours, or Green to Red by health.
zhCN text: 采用职业颜色，或随生命值降低由绿变红。

English key: Behind the health on raid-style frames.
zhCN text: 团队风格框体中生命条后面的背景。

English key: The names and numbers' font. Your Own Font: as CF Look > Font says.
zhCN text: 姓名和数值的字体。自定义字体方法见“CF 外观 → 字体”。

English key: The leader crown and guide icon.
zhCN text: 队长皇冠和团队向导标记。
坦克／治疗／伤害输出职责图标。

English key: On: while the Party Wheel is open, a gold box on the party frame of who you point at.
zhCN text: 开启后，队友轮盘打开时，当前指向的队友会在小队框体上显示金色高亮方框。

English key: The mana / rage / energy bar's fill (and a druid's mana bar in forms).
zhCN text: 法力／怒气／能量资源条的填充效果（包括德鲁伊变形时的法力条）。

English key: Behind each bar: the game's dark frame, a flat dark one, solid black or nothing.
zhCN text: 资源条背景可使用游戏原生暗色框、扁平暗色、纯黑或完全透明。

English key: A thin line round each bar.
zhCN text: 为每条资源条添加细边线。
细边线的颜色（游戏原生为黑色）。

English key: The numbers' font. Your Own Font: as CF Look > Font says.
zhCN text: 资源数字的字体。自定义字体方法见“CF 外观 → 字体”。

English key: A dark edge round the numbers.
On: Controller Forever's cast bar above your buttons, or none at all (the row below). Off: the game's own cast bar.
zhCN text: 开启后，使用动作按钮上方的 CF 自定义施法条，也可选择隐藏。关闭后则使用游戏原生施法条。

English key: The bar's texture: Classic, Flat, Smooth or Glass.
zhCN text: 选择施法条纹理：经典、扁平、平滑或玻璃效果。

English key: Gold, your class color, or a fixed color.
zhCN text: 使用金色、职业颜色或指定的固定颜色。

English key: The bright edge that rides the front of the bar.
zhCN text: 施法条填充前沿的高亮光效。

English key: The icon of the spell you're casting, left of the bar.
zhCN text: 施法条左侧显示正在施放技能的图标。

English key: The name of the spell on the bar.
zhCN text: 施法条上显示的法术名称。

English key: Time left, time left and the full cast time, or no numbers.
zhCN text: 可仅显示剩余施法时间，同时显示剩余及总施法时间，或完全隐藏数字。

English key: A mark for each tick of a channel, so you can stop between ticks.
zhCN text: 为引导法术的每次生效间隔绘制标记，便于在合适的跳数后结束引导。

English key: The last tick mark is gold: safe to move on.
zhCN text: 最后一次引导生效标记显示为金色，便于判断何时可以安全移动。

English key: A red zone the size of your ping at the end. Press your next spell when the fill reaches it.
zhCN text: 施法条末端显示代表当前网络延迟的红色区域。进度达到红区时可以提前按下一个技能。
超出距离时施法条置灰

English key: The bar turns gray while your target is out of range.
zhCN text: 当前目标超出技能射程时，施法条显示为灰色。

English key: On: CF's look for the minimap (the rows below).
zhCN text: 开启后，为游戏小地图应用下方设置的 CF 外观。

English key: Size of the dots on the map.
zhCN text: 调整小地图上各种标记点的大小。

English key: The map zooms back out by itself after this long.
zhCN text: 经过设定时间后，小地图自动缩回默认比例。

English key: Glow or Neon border: it slowly pulses.
zhCN text: 发光或霓虹边框可以缓慢呼吸闪烁。
让圆形小地图边框旋转。

English key: The zone name bar over the map.
zhCN text: 小地图上方的区域名称条。

English key: Your map coordinates on the minimap.
zhCN text: 在小地图上显示角色所在坐标。

English key: Frame rate and ping on the map.
zhCN text: 在小地图上显示帧率和网络延迟。
区域名称与时钟背景框

English key: Zone name and clock in small dark boxes. Experimental.
zhCN text: 在深色小方框中显示区域名称和时钟（实验性）。

English key: Size of the zone name, clock and coordinates.
zhCN text: 区域名称、时钟及坐标文字的大小。

English key: The + / - zoom buttons: on mouse over, always, or hidden.
zhCN text: 放大／缩小按钮可以设为鼠标悬停时显示、始终显示或隐藏。

English key: The calendar button by the map.
The tracking button by the map.
The new-mail icon by the map.
zhCN text: 小地图旁的新邮件提示图标。

English key: The dungeon difficulty flag on the map.
zhCN text: 小地图上的地下城难度标记。
其他插件的小地图按钮

English key: The buttons other addons put round the minimap.
zhCN text: 其他插件添加在小地图周围的按钮。

English key: Who pinged the minimap shows for a few seconds.
zhCN text: 在小地图上显示发出地图标记信号的玩家姓名，持续几秒钟。

English key: On: CF's look for the chat (the rows below).
zhCN text: 开启后，为聊天窗口应用下方设置的 CF 外观。

English key: The whole chat fades out after this long with nothing new said. A new line, or opening it to type, brings it back.
zhCN text: 聊天窗口在指定时间内没有新消息时自动淡出；出现新消息或打开输入框时重新显示。

English key: How long each line stays before it fades out on its own (the game's own fade).
zhCN text: 每条聊天消息保留多长时间，然后按游戏原生效果自动淡出。

English key: Behind the chat: the game's, none, a colour, or a fade.
zhCN text: 聊天窗口背景可选择游戏原生、无背景、固定颜色或淡出效果。

English key: Always, or only with the pointer over the chat.
zhCN text: 始终显示，或仅当鼠标指针悬停聊天窗口时显示。

English key: The chat text font. Your Own Font: as CF Look > Font says.
zhCN text: 聊天字体。自定义字体设置见“CF 外观 → 字体”。

English key: The chat text size, every window.
zhCN text: 所有聊天窗口中文字的大小。

English key: The time in front of each line.
zhCN text: 在每条聊天消息前显示时间。

English key: Player names in their class colour.
zhCN text: 按职业颜色显示玩家姓名。
综合频道与战斗日志标签。

English key: A tab flashes with a new message.
zhCN text: 有新消息时，对应聊天标签会闪烁。

English key: Flat: plain dark tabs with an accent line under the one you are on. Experimental.
zhCN text: 扁平：暗色简洁标签，当前标签下方显示强调色线条（实验性）。
聊天输入框的边框样式。

English key: The menu, channel and friends buttons by the chat.
zhCN text: 聊天窗口旁的菜单、频道及好友按钮。

English key: The scroll bar and Jump to Bottom button.
zhCN text: 滚动条和“跳至底部”按钮。

English key: At the End: items first, every empty slot after.
zhCN text: 先显示所有物品，再将空栏位集中排在末尾。

English key: The item level in white, or in the item's quality colour (green, blue, purple). It starts as your Bags skin has it.
zhCN text: 物品等级可以显示为白色或对应的品质颜色（绿、蓝、紫）；初始设置与背包皮肤一致。

English key: The item level on weapons and armor.
zhCN text: 在武器与护甲上显示物品等级。

English key: The item level in white, or the item's quality colour. Experimental.
zhCN text: 物品等级显示为白色，或按物品品质着色（实验性）。

English key: Gray junk is darkened, with a coin on it.
zhCN text: 灰色垃圾图标显示为较暗颜色，并加上金币标记。

English key: The sparkle on new items. Experimental.
zhCN text: 为新获得的物品显示闪光效果（实验性）。

English key: Flat: no slot frames, a thin edge in the item's quality colour. Experimental.
zhCN text: 扁平：不显示栏位底框，仅用物品品质色绘制细边线（实验性）。

English key: Flat slots: how thick each item's edge is. Experimental.
zhCN text: 扁平栏位中每个物品边线的粗细（实验性）。

English key: Flat slots: the edge colour. Experimental.
zhCN text: 扁平栏位中物品的边框颜色（实验性）。

English key: How see-through that background is. Experimental.
zhCN text: 背景的不透明度（实验性）。

English key: On: CF's look for the damage meter (the rows below).
zhCN text: 开启后，为伤害统计面板应用下方 CF 外观设置。
调整伤害统计面板透明度。

English key: The bar along the top of the meter.
zhCN text: 伤害统计面板顶部的标题栏。

English key: The scroll bar on the side.

zhCN text: CF 伤害统计：显示指标

English key: DPS, Damage, Healing, HPS, Damage Taken, Deaths or Threat (your group's threat on your target). Left / right.
zhCN text: 选择 DPS、总伤害、治疗量、每秒治疗量 HPS、承受伤害、死亡或仇恨（队伍对当前目标的仇恨）。左右方向键切换。
CF 伤害统计：显示行数

English key: How many players it shows (3 to 10). Your own row is always one of them.
zhCN text: 设置显示玩家人数（3–10），你自己的数据始终包含在内。
CF 伤害统计：第二面板
CF 伤害统计：第二面板指标

English key: What the second panel shows: Threat, DPS, Damage, Healing, HPS, Damage Taken or Deaths. Left / right.
zhCN text: 第二面板可显示仇恨、DPS、总伤害、治疗、HPS、承受伤害或死亡。左右方向键切换。

English key: CF's Meter: Move the Second Meter
zhCN text: CF 伤害统计：移动第二面板

English key: The look of each bar's fill.
zhCN text: 设置各条统计数据的填充纹理。
所有统计条使用同一种颜色。
每条统计数据填充部分的背景。

English key: Every other bar a little lighter.
zhCN text: 让相邻统计行交替使用深浅不同的背景色。

English key: A gold edge on the top bar.
zhCN text: 为排名第一的条目添加金色边框。

English key: The names' and numbers' font. Your Own Font: as CF Look > Font says.
zhCN text: 玩家名称与数据数字的字体。自定义字体见“CF 外观 → 字体”。
伤害或治疗的具体数值。
伤害统计面板的整体背景。
游戏原生拍卖行输入键盘

English key: The most one press of A spends in the Controller Auction House; pricier buys ask for A again. Left / right: 1g a step.
zhCN text: 在 CF 手柄拍卖行中，低于该金额时按一次 A 即可购买；超过金额时需要再次按 A 确认。左右方向键每次调整 1 金币。

English key: In the Controller Auction House the back buttons jump to the previous / next section of a list, or work as left and right.
zhCN text: 在手柄拍卖行中，背键可跳至列表上一／下一分区，也可以作为左右方向键使用。
拍卖行：使用文本显示金币

English key: Prices as 3g 30s 40c instead of coin pictures, easier to read from the couch.
zhCN text: 将拍卖价格显示为 3g 30s 40c 这样的文字，而不是金币图标，从较远位置更易阅读。
拍卖行：同时显示游戏原生提示框

English key: On: the game's gryphons sit at the ends of your bars. Move and size each one in Edit Layout.
zhCN text: 开启后，在动作条两端显示游戏原生狮鹫装饰；可在“编辑布局”中单独移动和缩放。

English key: Both sides bigger or smaller together. Left / right. LT / RT in Edit Layout sizes one.
zhCN text: 同时调整左右两侧装饰的大小。左右方向键一起缩放；在编辑布局中可通过 LT／RT 单独调整一侧。

English key: On: each side faces the other way.
zhCN text: 开启后，左右装饰朝向与原来相反。
角色下方的生命／资源条

English key: CF Meter, or skin the game's
zhCN text: 使用 CF 伤害统计或美化游戏原生统计
为所有外观模块应用统一风格。

English key: Fonts for the skins and all game text.
zhCN text: 皮肤和所有游戏文本的字体。

English key: CF's own menu and windows: their look, whatever your skins.
zhCN text: CF 设置菜单和自定义窗口的外观，不受其他皮肤影响。
使用文字显示金币金额
没有符合搜索条件的结果。

English key: It stays: the D-pad moves, X uses, B closes. Picking up and More wait for its end.
zhCN text: 战斗中仍可用方向键浏览、X 使用、B 关闭；拿起物品及更多操作需要脱战后才能进行。

English key: Lit because you used it last time: open, X, B is three presses.
zhCN text: 因为上次使用过而高亮：按“打开 → X → B”即可用三个按键完成操作。
为你的单位框体应用 CF 外观。

English key: Health, power and what's on them.
zhCN text: 调整生命条、资源条及相关显示内容。

English key: Glows, badges and the Party Wheel's pick.
zhCN text: 高亮、状态标记与队友轮盘的选中提示。
游戏原生拍卖行输入键盘
动作条两端的狮鹫装饰

English key: Start as a button of your own.
zhCN text: 将 Start 作为独立按键。
编辑布局：同时调整 L3／R3

English key: Click a stick for a bind of your own.
zhCN text: 按下摇杆即可触发自己设置的技能或操作。
优先交互，否则切换目标

English key: Put Healing Potion on a Button
zhCN text: 将治疗药水绑定到按键

English key: Put Mana Potion on a Button
zhCN text: 将法力药水绑定到按键

English key: Put Best Food on a Button
zhCN text: 将最高级食物绑定到按键

English key: Put Best Water on a Button
zhCN text: 将最高级饮料绑定到按键

English key: Put Eat and Drink on a Button
zhCN text: 将吃喝恢复绑定到按键
遵循地面指向法术设置

English key: Edit Layout: LT / RT Target Icons
zhCN text: 编辑布局：LT / RT 目标图标
显示 LT / RT 目标图标
显示 LB / RB 目标图标

English key: On: tap LT or RT and its modifier stays on until you tap again. Held while you press a button, it's a normal hold.
zhCN text: 开启后，轻按 LT 或 RT 可将该组合键层保持激活，直至再次轻按。按住扳机键同时按其他键时，仍按普通长按方式处理。
不适用于 LT／RT 选目标模式

English key: On: with a trigger locked, the next button you press uses that set, then the lock comes off.
zhCN text: 开启后，如果扳机键已锁定，则下一次按键使用对应组合键层，随后自动解除锁定。
显示 LB / RB 图标

English key: Set Up Your Important Default Binds
zhCN text: 设置重要的默认快捷键

English key: The default binds - Jump, Interact, the wheels, the map and more - one by one beside All Keybinds: bind each, pick another button or skip.
zhCN text: 依次为跳跃、交互、快捷轮盘、地图等操作设置默认快捷键。可以选择按键、另选按键或跳过。

English key: Set up your controller, find your way round the menu, move and talk.
zhCN text: 配置手柄，熟悉设置菜单、移动与 NPC 对话。

English key: Pick targets your way and read your buttons in a fight.
zhCN text: 学会按照自己的习惯选择目标，并在战斗中识别动作按钮。

English key: Put your spells on your buttons, with every page and set there is.
zhCN text: 为技能设置动作按钮，熟悉各组合键层与页面。

English key: Choose your layout, then move and size anything with Edit Layout.
zhCN text: 选择布局，再通过编辑模式移动或缩放界面元素。

English key: Pick a ready-made look, or make every part your own.
zhCN text: 选用预设外观，或自定义所有界面元素。

English key: Heal and buff your party from the controller, your enemy still targeted.
zhCN text: 使用手柄给队友治疗和施加增益，同时保留当前敌对目标。

English key: Wheels, the camera, vibration, handy helpers, and keeping your setup safe.
zhCN text: 快捷轮盘、镜头、振动、便利功能及配置备份。

English key: On: the Xbox / Home button is a button of your own. Set it up below first.
zhCN text: 开启后，Xbox／Home 键可作为独立按钮。请先在下方完成设置。

English key: A, then press your Xbox button so the addon learns it. Nothing? Map it to a key like F13 in Steam Input.
zhCN text: 按 A 开始检测，然后按下手柄的 Xbox／Home 键。如果没有反应，可使用 Steam Input 将其映射为 F13 等键盘按键。

English key: The Xbox / Home button as a button of your own.
zhCN text: 将 Xbox／Home 键设为独立按键。
暂时无法修改收藏列表。

English key: Y on an item adds one
zhCN text: 在物品上按 Y 添加一项收藏
来自已有扫描，无需重新等待

English key: No full scan yet: prices come as you look.
zhCN text: 尚未进行完整扫描；浏览物品时会逐步获取价格。

English key: A search you made. A shows it again.
zhCN text: 你之前搜索过的内容，按 A 可再次查看。
按 A 立即打开并浏览。

English key: All of them as a list.
zhCN text: 将所有收藏项显示为列表。

English key: Nothing found. Try fewer letters, or Select to change the filters.
zhCN text: 没有搜索结果。试着缩短关键词，或按 Select 修改筛选条件。
未找到结果，请减少搜索关键词。

English key: Nothing with these filters. Select to change them.
zhCN text: 当前筛选条件下没有结果。按 Select 修改筛选。

English key: No filters on. Select opens them.
zhCN text: 当前没有启用筛选条件，按 Select 打开设置。

English key: On switches A turns it on or off · on numbers the D-pad changes it
zhCN text: 对于开关选项，按 A 启用或关闭；对于数字选项，使用十字方向键调整数值。

English key: The price was let go: A asks again.
zhCN text: 之前保留的价格已失效，按 A 重新查询。

English key: Someone bought them first. Prices updated.
zhCN text: 其他人先完成了购买，价格列表已更新。

English key: The price ran out: A asks again.
zhCN text: 报价已过期，按 A 重新查询。

English key: An old price was still held: press A again.
zhCN text: 仍有一笔旧价格被锁定；请再按一次 A 继续。

English key: A does nothing until the answer comes.
zhCN text: 在服务器返回结果之前，A 键暂时不可用。

English key: A fight started: the price was let go.
zhCN text: 进入战斗后，之前锁定的价格已取消。
其他玩家先购买了这件物品。

English key: No favourites yet. Y on an item adds one.
zhCN text: 暂时没有收藏项。在物品上按 Y 即可添加。
暂时无法使用收藏功能。
你会损失该拍卖的保证金。

English key: Yours is the cheapest of its kind.
zhCN text: 你目前的挂单是同类物品中价格最低的。

English key: A comes back when the answer arrives.
zhCN text: 服务器返回价格后，A 键会恢复可用。

English key: It's no longer in your bags.
zhCN text: 这件物品已经不在你的背包中。
按 X 输入一个数字。

English key: In a fight. The AH waits.
zhCN text: 战斗中，拍卖行操作需要等待脱战。

English key: Your buttons are yours until the fight ends.
zhCN text: 战斗结束前，手柄按键仍执行原有战斗操作。

English key: (the enchant on yours is not counted)
zhCN text: （未计入你当前装备的附魔效果）

English key: The game's own window is asking.
zhCN text: 请先在游戏原生确认窗口中完成操作。

English key: The same buttons on every screen
zhCN text: 所有界面采用相同的按键操作
始终二次按 A 确认

English key: Back buttons can be set up out of combat.
zhCN text: 请脱离战斗后设置手柄背键。

English key: That waits until you leave combat.
zhCN text: 此操作需要等到脱战后进行。

English key: Can't swap the fishing pole in a fight yet - try again after
zhCN text: 战斗中暂不能替换鱼竿，请脱战再试。
无法在此处销毁该物品。

English key: Bound to you: it can't go there.
zhCN text: 此物品已与你绑定，不能放到那里。

English key: Empty slots are one count, not rows of blank squares. Pick something up with A, then A here puts it in the first free slot.
zhCN text: 空栏位合并显示为数字，而非一排空格。先按 A 拿起物品，再在这里按 A 即可放入第一个空栏位。

English key: the game asks to be sure
Put It on a CF Button
zhCN text: 放到 CF 动作按钮上

English key: press the button you want it on
zhCN text: 请按下想要绑定该物品的按键

English key: Full Window: a big one in the middle, with a card on the item you're on. Simple: a small one where the game's bags open.
zhCN text: 完整窗口：屏幕中央显示大背包窗口，旁边附有所选物品详情；简易窗口：使用游戏原生背包位置的小型窗口。

English key: In a fight it works too: the D-pad moves, X uses a potion, B closes.
zhCN text: 战斗中仍可使用：方向键浏览，X 使用药水，B 关闭窗口。

English key: Holding an item, A here puts it in the first free slot on this side.
zhCN text: 拿着物品时，在这里按 A 可放入此侧的第一个空栏位。

English key: Tops up a stack of it first, then the first free slot.
zhCN text: 优先合并到已有同种物品组，再放入第一个空栏位。

English key: Hidden: its items go in Other
zhCN text: 隐藏：其物品归入“其他”分类

English key: none of yours, nothing hidden, the usual order
zhCN text: 移除全部自定义分类，不隐藏任何物品，并恢复默认顺序。

English key: Hidden: its items go in Other.
zhCN text: 隐藏该分类后，相关物品将归入“其他”。

English key: Pick a kind of item: Skinning, Mining, Potions, Recipes and more. Its section takes those items before the usual ones.
zhCN text: 选择物品类别，例如剥皮材料、采矿材料、药水、配方等。新建分类会优先于常规分类收纳对应物品。

English key: Your sections take their items first: an ore goes in Mining, not Trade Goods. New and Quest still come first.
zhCN text: 自定义分类优先收纳对应物品：例如矿石优先进入“采矿材料”，而不是“交易物品”；但“新物品”和“任务物品”仍排在最前。

English key: Order is Bag by Bag now: your sections show with Order: By Kind.
zhCN text: 当前按各个背包分别排列；如需显示自定义分类，请将排序改为“按类型”。
最小背包，建议优先升级

English key: It grows as you get keys, and can't be changed.
zhCN text: 钥匙链容量会随获得的钥匙自动扩展，无法手动修改。

English key: Always there: it can't be changed.
zhCN text: 此栏位始终存在，无法更改。
这是容量最小的背包，建议优先替换。

English key: Drawn by the window itself, with sample items.
zhCN text: 窗口使用示例物品绘制预览。

English key: Change this out of a fight.
zhCN text: 请脱离战斗后修改此设置。

English key: Can't undo a bind in combat.
zhCN text: 战斗中无法撤销按键绑定。
